votes.motion: Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting

Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, made a motion to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township Council meetings held on Tuesday, January 25, 2022, February 8, 2022, and February 22, 2022
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to open the public hearing
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the public hearing
